project.name: osgi/pipeline
project.description: The passive fluent-pipeline grammar engine: FluentTopicRunner (logs entry/exit with elapsed time, wraps any throw inside the body as TopicFailure carrying the topic label), plus the OnFailure SAM and the TopicFailure exception. PURE logic, slf4j-only, no @Component / no framework boot — so it is dual-consumable: a real OSGi bundle at BUILD time (jar + bnd metadata + per-package @Version), yet at RUNTIME equally usable flat on the host classloader (system-exported for type resolution). Unifies the two byte-identical copies that drifted apart (seed-master's TopicRunner + manifests-core's SynthesisTopicRunner).
